name: Mevra
description: A hunt leader related to Yasova whose shape is stolen by Nicol Bolas; she is almost certainly dead.

description_citations.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
description_citations.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: From a hidden cleft the group watches Fec speak with a pregnant woman who resembles Mevra and claims an illness killed the camp.
timeline.quote: An illness ate away their lives and brought them death. I am all that is left.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Naiva sees the false Mevra gliding down the path with feet off the ground and calls her out.
timeline.quote: You aren't Mevra. You're no kin of mine.
